entries.text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
It is not what you look at that matters, it is what you see.
Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.
The mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation.
The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
That man is the richest whose pleasures are the cheapest.
Not till we are lost, in other words, not till we have lost the world, do we begin to find ourselves.
Live each season as it passes; breathe the air, drink the drink, taste the fruit, and resign yourself to the influences of each.
If a man does not keep pace with his companions, perhaps it is because he hears a different drummer.
As a single footstep will not make a path on the earth, so a single thought will not make a pathway in the mind.
To affect the quality of the day, that is the highest of arts.
The sun is but a morning star.
Every morning was a cheerful invitation to make my life of equal simplicity, and I may say innocence, with Nature herself.
I have learned this, at least, by my experiment: that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
Things do not change; we change.
Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.
Time is but the stream I go a-fishing in.
What's the use of a fine house if you haven't got a tolerable planet to put it on?
I had three chairs in my house; one for solitude, two for friendship, three for society.
The question is not what you look at, but what you see.
There is no remedy for love but to love more.
How vain it is to sit down to write when you have not stood up to live.
I have never found a companion that was so companionable as solitude.
Heaven is under our feet as well as over our heads.
